# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** Six or seven years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy is a young child who is the twin sister of Robin.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)_

## Personality

Lucy is quiet, demure, and impressionable. She can be easily frightened by unsettling stories told by her peers, such as tales of deceased relatives and wandering ghosts.

_Sources: [v2 c19 P49](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0049), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)_

## Traits

- Demure  <sub>[v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Quiet  <sub>[v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Easily frightened by ghost stories  <sub>[v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)</sub>
- Fear of the dark  <sub>[v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003)</sub>

## History

Lucy began attending school alongside her twin brother Robin. At Sunday School, she made an agreement with Lily Mott to sit together, but when Lily failed to show up on the first day of school, Lucy was provisionally seated next to Mirabel Cotton. During class, Mirabel told Lucy graphic details about her deceased relatives and claimed her uncle roamed her house as a ghost after burial. This frightened Lucy so severely that she wept at home and became terrified of going up to bed alone in the dark. Nell comforted her, took her to bed, and stayed with her until she fell asleep, subsequently disciplining Mirabel the next day. On another occasion, Lucy did not have much of an appetite and ate only half of a large slice of bread and jam given to her, passing the rest back to Robin. Nell also planned a picnic to the shore dunes by punt for Lucy and Robin.

_Sources: [v2 c16 P37](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0037), [v2 c19 P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 c19 P49](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0049), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c21 P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008)_
